questions.title: How to check if a golf ball is yours
questions.question: You find a golf ball on the course and think it might be yours, but you are not sure. What should you do to check if it's your ball without breaking any rules?

choices.text: Pick it up and clean it as much as you want, then put it back anywhere nearby.
Put a marker on the ground next to the ball, carefully lift it to look, only clean enough to see if it’s yours, and then put it back exactly where it was.
Leave the ball there and play with a new ball instead.
Pick it up, clean it all over, and put it closer to the hole.

questions.explanation: If you want to check if a ball is yours, you must put a marker down first. Then lift the ball and clean it just a little bit—only enough to see your name or mark. Put the ball back where it was. This way you follow the rules and don't get a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A small coin or token you use to show where your ball was on the ground.

questions.teachingTip: Let children practise marking, lifting, checking, and replacing their ball on the same spot with a friend watching.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids may forget to put a marker down before lifting the ball.
Some may clean the ball too much or put it back in the wrong place.

questions.title: What to do if you can't tell if the ball is yours
questions.question: You find a golf ball that might be yours, but you're not sure. What is the correct way to identify it without getting a penalty?

choices.text: Pick it up and clean it however you like, then replace it anywhere nearby.
Mark where the ball is, carefully lift it to check, clean only as much as needed to identify it, and put it back on the exact spot.
Ignore the ball and continue play with a different ball.
Pick it up, fully clean it, and place it closer to the hole.

questions.explanation: You must mark the position of the ball first, then lift and clean it just enough to see if it's yours. Afterwards, you have to put it back where it was. If you skip marking or clean it more than necessary, you could get a penalty.
